title: AOA rc.8 A7 fork read-back (and post-SEND live read-back)
description: One file per read-back. source = fork (A7 dump) or live (two-RPC after SEND); both use this schema. Every field is present; a value that cannot be produced uses the valueState encoding, never omission. Every on-chain value is read at header.readbackBlock.

contracts.description: Keys are the SDK pins names (superPaymaster, superPaymasterLens, registry, policyRegistry, blsAggregator, dvtValidator, reputationSystem, disclosureRegistry, xPNTsFactoryV2, xPNTsTokenV2Impl, xPNTsTokenV2Ext, aoaProtocolRegistry, globalTierSource, aPNTsCapped, gTokenStaking, entryPoint, ownerSafe, multiSendCallOnly). SDK book entries are referenced elsewhere as "addresses.<key>". ALL keys in `required` (the full rc.8 release set) must be present; a contract that is not deployed is still present with every field "n/a:not deployed". The SDK pins fields spImpl / registryImpl are the erc1967Impl fields of superPaymaster / registry, not separate keys.

checks.description: Named assertions and scalar facts (e.g. "dvtValidator.categoryCount", "blsAggregator.MAX_VALIDATORS", "superPaymaster.OPERATOR_WITHDRAWAL_WINDOW"). Each key is "<contractKey>.<name>" or "<contractKey>.<a> == <contractKey>.<b>".

unreadable.description: The call exists but failed; text after the colon is the reason.

notApplicable.description: The field does not apply to this contract; text after the colon is the reason.

absent.description: The selector is ABSENT from the compiled artifact's ABI at header.spCommit (decided from the ABI, never by calling: a fallback-routing contract answers every selector). Only spAdminExtension and xPNTsTokenV2Ext use it for version.

anyValue.description: A scalar, list or object read on chain, or a valueState. Integers above 2^53 are decimal strings.

hardfork.description: "amsterdam" for Sepolia; each chain's real tier.

forkBlock.description: Upstream block the fork starts from (live: the block the send landed after).

anvilVersion.description: Full `anvil --version` first line; n/a for live.

dumpSha256.description: sha256 of the anvil_dumpState file; n/a for live.

providers.description: Upstream provider NAMES only (e.g. alchemy, tenderly); never URLs.

ethConfig.description: UPSTREAM eth_config.current read at forkBlock (not the fork's own eth_config).

corroboration.description: Second provider without eth_config: presence of Amsterdam-only header fields at blockNumber.

contract.description: Common fields; contract-specific fields (e.g. signerMaskOrder, guardianSet, immutables, threshold, owners) are additional keys whose values follow anyValue.

roles.description: "n/a:no role system" for every contract without one.

initcode.description: CREATE init code sent as tx data with to = null.

method.description: How each number is produced, e.g. eth_estimateGas({from, data}) at forkBlock; tx receipt gasUsed.

estimateLive.description: provider name -> live eth_estimateGas at forkBlock. RECORDED, NOT JUDGED (an upstream estimate may add headroom).

estimateFork.description: eth_estimateGas on the fork, same block/sender/data. RECORDED, NOT JUDGED.

gasUsedFork.description: WHOLE-TRANSACTION receipt gasUsed on the fork (not the CREATE frame only).

gasUsed.description: SP-recorded whole-tx receipt gasUsed on the A7 fork.

predicate.description: Machine-checkable pass rule (DSR): for every provider p with an integer estimateSimulate[p]: estimateSimulate[p] == gasUsedFork == expected.gasUsed; AND callAtGasUsed[p] is true for every provider. estimateLive, estimateFork and callAtGasUsedMinusOne are recorded only. At least one provider must supply estimateSimulate.

estimateSimulate.description: provider name -> eth_simulateV1 gasUsed of the same call at forkBlock, or n/a:<reason> if the provider has no eth_simulateV1. JUDGED.

callAtGasUsed.description: provider name -> eth_call with gas = expected.gasUsed succeeds. JUDGED.

callAtGasUsedMinusOne.description: provider name -> eth_call with gas = expected.gasUsed - 1 succeeds. RECORDED, NOT JUDGED.

contractNoVersionShape.description: Same fields as contract, but version() does not exist by design: version must be null.

roles.description: "n/a:no role system" for every contract without one.

contractWithRoles.description: A contract with a role system: roles is an object of role -> holders.

roles.description: Role name -> holders, for contracts with a role system only (registry, timelockController).

x-readMethods._: How each field is read independently at header.readbackBlock (consumers re-read the same way).
x-readMethods.address: From the manifest address book for the contract key; codehash = eth_getCode at readbackBlock, keccak256.
x-readMethods.version: eth_call version() if version() is in the compiled ABI at spCommit; else null.
x-readMethods.erc1967Impl: eth_getStorageAt(proxy, 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc) for ERC-1967 proxies (superPaymaster, registry); else n/a.
x-readMethods.extension: superPaymaster: eth_call EXTENSION(); extensionCodehash = codehash of that address and MUST equal contracts.spAdminExtension.codehash. Others: n/a.
x-readMethods.owner/pendingOwner: eth_call owner() and pendingOwner() where in the ABI. Registry: pendingOwner() is the public getter of Ownable2StepNamespaced (contracts/src/utils/Ownable2StepNamespaced.sol:57); its storage is the ERC-7201 slot keccak256(abi.encode(uint256(keccak256("aastar.storage.Ownership2Step")) - 1)) & ~bytes32(uint256(0xff)) = 0xdb5a3168abaa6147a9f3a4cb66016161119d4d50b6393344d27120286f742a00 (OWNERSHIP_2STEP_SLOT, :35-36), usable as a cross-check.
x-readMethods.roles: Only for contracts with a role system: registry (its own roles: hasRole(bytes32,address); RoleGranted/RoleRevoked/RoleRegistered/RoleExited logs per IRegistry.sol:74-91) and an OpenZeppelin TimelockController if the manifest deploys one (AccessControl: hasRole, RoleGranted/RoleRevoked). Candidates come from those logs over [deploymentBlock, readbackBlock], each confirmed with hasRole at readbackBlock; the range goes under rolesSource. Every other contract (no role system, e.g. gTokenStaking, which has only role LOCKS) writes roles = "n/a:no role system".
x-readMethods.blsAggregator.guardianSet: For slot s in 1..MAX_VALIDATORS: validatorAtSlot(uint8 s) (public mapping, BLSAggregator.sol:204); for each nonzero address, getBLSPublicKey(address) (BLSAggregator.sol:907) -> pubkeyHash = keccak256(abi.encode(publicKey)), slot, isActive.
x-readMethods.blsAggregator.signerMaskOrder: Bit i of signerMask (i = 0..63) selects slot i+1: _reconstructPkAgg loops slot = 1..MAX_VALIDATORS and tests (signerMask >> (slot - 1)) & 1 (BLSAggregator.sol:1281-1284); slot -> address via validatorAtSlot.
x-readMethods.blsAggregator.thresholds: slashThresholds(uint8 level) (public mapping, BLSAggregator.sol:314) for each SlashLevel; minThreshold(), defaultThreshold(), SLASH_THRESHOLD_FLOOR(), MAX_VALIDATORS().
x-readMethods.blsAggregator.verifier: fraudProofVerifier(), pendingFraudProofVerifier() (BLSAggregator.sol:429), pendingFraudProofVerifierReadyAt() (uint64, :430), DVT_VALIDATOR(), domainSeparator(); thresholds also as fields minThreshold(), defaultThreshold(), SLASH_THRESHOLD_FLOOR().
x-readMethods.disclosureRegistry: version() and every immutable getter in its ABI (WRITER(), AGGREGATOR(), …).
x-readMethods.ownerSafe: version = VERSION() (Safe exposes VERSION(), not version()); getThreshold(), getOwners(), singleton = eth_getStorageAt(safe, 0).
x-readMethods.checks: Each check names its getter in the key; values are read, never copied from the plan.
x-readMethods.entryPoint: getDepositInfo(superPaymaster) -> deposit, staked, stake, unstakeDelaySec, withdrawTime, recorded as fields of contracts.entryPoint (EntryPoint v0.7 IStakeManager.DepositInfo).
x-readMethods.evaluationCommunityToken: The evaluation community's xPNTs token instance: creditPolicy(), policyEpoch(), pendingPolicy(), pendingPolicyEta(), issuanceCap(), SUPERPAYMASTER_ADDRESS() (xPNTsV2Base.sol:72-120). POLICY_OFF() is read on chain too; the check compares the two reads.
x-readMethods.externalVersion: EntryPoint v0.7 and MultiSendCallOnly have no version(): version = "n/a:<reason>"; their identity is the codehash, pinned by the manifest to the canonical deployments (EntryPoint 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032; MultiSendCallOnly at the official address for the release).
